$comment: Save-worthy #3: GTM/SEO tasks sorted by the shape of their answer. CODE reasons are TypeSafe's own documented failure modes for jev-1.13 (not a calculator; dates read as text). Examples are illustrative tasks, no figures.
title: Code, Jev, or *an LLM?*
sub: Sort every GTM and SEO step by the shape of its answer, not by how smart it sounds.
readout: Ask in order:  number or date? *CODE*  ·  closed answer set? *JEV*  ·  must write words? *LLM*

columns.label: CODE
columns.rule: A number, a date, or a rule you already decided.

items.why: Arithmetic. Jev is documented as not a calculator.
Jev reads dates as text, not quantities.
A policy, not a judgement. Pre-filter.
Arithmetic again. Compute it, then ask.
A date window. Compute it in code.

columns.label: JEV
columns.rule: A closed answer set a person answers in one second.

items.why: choice with UNRESOLVED, never a forced tier
Build candidates in code. Jev picks one.

items.task: Is this page on-topic for the cluster?

items.why: Generation. Downstream of a Jev decision.
Generation, after Jev tagged it objection.
Generation. Jev can pick which ones to answer.
